name: EmbarkStudios/puffin
description: A friendly lightweight instrumentation profiler for Rust games and applications, featuring flamegraph visualization, remote profiling over TCP, and egui integration for in-game performance monitoring.
score_rationale: 1.7k stars, dual Apache-2.0/MIT, the primary profiling tool for Rust game development used in production by Embark Studios.
summary: Lightweight Rust profiler with flamegraph and in-game visualization
